mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the Federal Funds rate above 5.25% for three consecutive months reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, lowering the present value of expected dividends and earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.25% and remains above for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns over the horizon are positive and statistically significant (p < 0.05), or the 3-month moving average of FEDFUNDS does not exceed 5.25% during the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) accompanied by a simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by > 10% in a month while UNRATE decreases by > 0.2 percentage points
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative or not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) during the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in personal consumption expenditures (CPIAUCSL) above 0.3% for three consecutive months indicates accelerating demand growth, which elevates expected future earnings and supports higher equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL monthly growth rate exceeds 0.3% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative or the 3-month moving average of CPIAUCSL growth does not exceed 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% followed by a rebound of over 4% in the subsequent month suggests a supply shock resolution, lowering uncertainty and encouraging risk-on positioning that produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO drops > 2% in one month then rises > 4% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are flat or negative, or the pattern of contraction/rebound does not occur.

mechanism_narrative: When the 3-month moving average of FEDFUNDS falls below 4%, it indicates a shift toward accommodative policy, lowering real interest rates and increasing the present value of future equity cash flows, which should produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or the 3-month FEDFUNDS average does not fall below 4% during the period.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in job openings (PAYEMS) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by at least 0.5 percentage points indicates a cooling labor market, raising recession risk and reducing equity risk appetite, which should drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decreases by > 10% while UNRATE increases by > 0.5 percentage points
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or the cooling signals are not concomitant (job openings rise while unemployment falls).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in retail sales (not available in provided proxies – skip this and use alternative) → instead: A 2-month decline in personal consumption (CPIAUCSL) followed by a month of stable data suggests weakening demand momentum, which typically precedes a pullback in equities; thus, negative 20-day forward returns are expected when this pattern is detected.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL decreases for two consecutive months then remains flat in the third
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the pattern window.

mechanism_narrative: When the ratio of industrial production to capacity utilization (not directly available – use INDPRO and HOUST proxy) shows a sharp increase, indicating underutilized capacity, it suggests potential for cost reductions and productivity gains that can support higher equity valuations and positive 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO / (100 - HOUST) increases by > 15% over a quarter
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are flat or negative, or the capacity utilization signal does not strengthen as predicted.
